**Boss:** [Rinzler](#loc=75361)

Note: Secret Portals are all super-powered versions of bosses from the game's plot. See the boss' map marker for strategies.
75361:
Rinzler is a relentless and fast melee attacker. Sora likely won't have time to use commands or extended Keyblade combos, so don't plan on those for your main strategy. Instead, focus your energy on Counter Rush, spamming it whenever he's close to you.

If you manage to use a rare Reality Shift, it with stagger Rinzler for a long period of time, so make good use of the opportunity!
